locations.name: Operations
locations.description: A compact coordination room overlooking the relay complex.

appearance.lighting: warm console glow under dim emergency strips

locations.name: Relay Chamber

appearance.architecture: cylindrical concrete chamber with steel service gantries
appearance.palette: cold blue, brushed steel, hazard yellow

locations.name: Infirmary

appearance.clothing: charcoal utility jacket with a plain station badge
dark station coat with a red command stripe

goals.description: Seal the relay before the unstable sample escapes containment.

relationships.reason: Sable has not yet judged the field coordinator under pressure.
Sable considers Orr talented but dangerously impulsive.
Sable respects Lin's careful technical judgment.

appearance.clothing: blue maintenance coveralls with rolled sleeves

goals.description: Broadcast the distress packet while the receiver is listening.

relationships.reason: Orr hopes the field coordinator will support a rescue attempt.
Orr believes Sable's caution may strand the crew.
Orr trusts Lin's science even when they disagree about priorities.

disclosures.topic: the rescue receiver's narrow handshake window
disclosures.content: The rescue receiver only opens its authenticated handshake for one minute. Our next and final window begins at mission minute twelve.

appearance.clothing: pale medical coat over an orange pressure vest

goals.description: Reach the Relay Chamber and purge the sample before it destabilizes.

relationships.reason: Lin is waiting to see whether the field coordinator acts responsibly.
Lin trusts Sable to take containment seriously.
Lin likes Orr but doubts his appetite for risk.

facts.value: The display shows three live controls: relay lockdown, distress broadcast, and sample purge. Activating any one will disable the other two.

npc_actions.label: Seal the relay
npc_actions.description: Trigger the irreversible relay lockdown from Operations.

observations.summary: Director Sable sealed the relay behind armored shutters, silencing the transmitter.

goals.reason: Sable sealed the unstable sample behind the relay shutters.
The sealed transmitter can no longer broadcast the distress packet.
The sealed relay made purging unnecessary and inaccessible.

effects.visible_message: Director Sable seals the relay. The transmitter falls silent behind armored shutters; the sample remains contained, but no distress call leaves the station.

npc_actions.label: Broadcast the distress packet
npc_actions.description: Use the transmitter's remaining power to call the listening rescue ship.

goal_factors.reason: Orr prioritizes reaching rescue while the receiver is listening

parameter_factors.reason: Orr's high risk tolerance favors acting during the narrow rescue window

belief_factors.reason: Orr believes a rescue ship can hear the broadcast
Orr believes energizing the relay would endanger containment

observations.summary: Technician Orr broadcast the distress packet and a rescue acknowledgment returned.

goals.reason: Orr sent the distress packet and received a rescue acknowledgment.
Energizing the relay left the unstable sample unsecured.
The broadcast ended the decision window before Lin could purge the sample.

effects.visible_message: Orr broadcasts the distress packet. A rescue acknowledgment returns, but the energized relay leaves the unstable sample unsecured.

npc_actions.label: Purge the sample
npc_actions.description: Vent the sample into the sterilization chamber, destroying it and the research it contains.

observations.summary: Dr. Lin purged the sample through the sterilization chamber, destroying it and its research value.

goals.reason: Lin destroyed the unstable sample in the sterilization chamber.
Purging the sample permanently contained the biological risk.
The purge consumed the immediate crisis response window before Orr broadcast.

effects.visible_message: Dr. Lin purges the sample. The contamination risk vanishes with years of research, while the relay remains available for a later rescue attempt.
